component.name: Game Optimization Linux
component.summary: Inspect and manage local Linux game libraries

description.p: Game Optimization Linux presents local Steam installations, storage information, and guarded optimization workflows.

ul.li: Redesigned Home, Library, game details, Updates, Tasks and Settings built on a shared design system with new icon glyphs.
Launcher logos for Steam, Heroic and Lutris, and a persistent motion setting (full, reduced or off).

Starts with the game, including Steam and Proton titles, after a fixed 15 second delay; an automatic session stops only after the game exit is confirmed twice, and a manually started session is never stopped automatically.
The saved capture window choice is reused; a cancelled or failed start no longer erases it.
One silent retry when the captured window changes (for example a splash window replaced by the main window), a silent stop on game exit, and one restart when no frames arrive.
Uses the first installed voice when the saved voice is missing and shows honest session states.
The subtitle region selector is fully usable with a controller: presets, moving and resizing.
Select+Y controller shortcut to start or stop the Narrator; delivery while a game has focus is still being investigated.
One-button online install with a confirmation before replacing existing files, backups, and handling of moved games; updated Desktop section.

Compression started from Couch Mode and automatic compression never ask for a password; the exact compsize measurement is a separate, confirmed action, and unmeasured values are shown as not measured.
Optional CPU, GPU and RAM usage next to the clock in Couch Mode, from real system sources only.
Controller input steers GameOpti only while its window is active, and connection diagnostics are written to the log.
Gamescope window mode, sharpness and FPS limit handling in game optimization.
Lutris game configurations are read from the data directory.
Donate page in Desktop Mode, synchronized translation catalogs and a system menu sound fix.

description.p: Major alpha update with experimental Polish narration, real-game performance analysis and automatic optimization improvements.
Flatpak host integration no longer requires a host Python runtime.
